h: Zamfara steps up Ebola screening after a traveller reportedly arrives with a fever
p: The Zamfara State government has reportedly activated Ebola surveillance at Gusau airport and major motor parks. This follows the arrival of a passenger from Saudi Arabia said to have had a 38-degree fever.
more: Health officials have urged residents to report anyone with symptoms.
It comes as the NCDC approves weekly payments for people placed under monitoring.
